normalized.description: The development of space debris population models and of architecture analyses of sensor networks depends on reliable detection simulation software. While such software exists for ground-based detectors, its adaptation to space-based platforms to address emergingspace-based small debris detection systems in Europe and globally is missing. Such a functionality will allow for comprehensive validation of models. This activity will start with well-qualified sensor models and crossing modules, refactoring them for space-basedscenarios, introduce state-of-the-art population processing, revise detection probability concepts, and ensure reproducibility of scenarios.
